children: stock surged 8.0% in Tuesday after-hours trading after the fintech delivered stronger-than-expected Q3 earnings and issued robust Q4 guidance. Q3 results climbed as gross payment volume jumped past consensus. Cash App and Square gross profit both grew by double-digit percentages.
The parent of the Square system for merchants and Cash App
of $1.15 vs. the consensus of $1.03, gross profit of $3.315B vs. the Visible Alpha consensus of $3.31B, and adjusted operating income of $1.001B vs. $923M in Q3.
The company expects to generate its first machine intelligence revenue in Q4. It started a pilot of Buzz, an environment for building and collaborating using machine intelligence, in October.
Q3 adjusted EPS of $1.13, topping the average analyst estimate of $1.03, rose from $1.02 in Q2 and $0.54 in last year’s Q3.
Gross payment volume of $78.2B, beating the Visible Alpha consensus of $77.2B, climbed from $74.7B in the previous quarter and $69.3B a year ago.

Gross profit climbed to $3.234B, exceeding the Visible Alpha consensus of $3.16B, from $3.17B in Q3 and $2.66B in Q4 2025. The Cash App ecosystem generated a gross profit of $2.07B, up 27% Y/Y, and Square’s gross profit of $1.16B grew 14% Y/Y.
The Bitcoin ecosystem gross profit of $52M vs. $72M in Q2 and $104M in last year’s Q3

"Neighborhoods was a key driver of Cash App scaling to 60M monthly transacting actives in September, and there is much more we plan to do to connect local communities in the future," Block's head Jack Dorsey said in his letter to shareholders. "We’re using bitcoin and stablecoins as an enabler of Cash App’s expansion and have begun externalizing our lending infrastructure through Cash App Score."
Non-GAAP operating expenses of $2.33B, vs. the Visible Alpha estimate of $2.30B, rose from $2.32B in the prior quarter and $2.20B a year ago.
Adjusted EBITDA of $1.23B, topping the $1.19B Visible Alpha estimate, increased from $1.17B in Q3 and $833M in last year’s Q3.
